Drawback: Visible Tell.name: Drawback: Visible Tell
Drawback: Visible Tell.description:
💡 Your Quirk announces itself: a glow, a sound, a smell, sparks or a change in your skin before and during each use.

⚠️ Hard to hide and impossible to sneak with.
👀 People remember it easily.
Drawback: Visible Tell.traitNarrativeEffects:
Every use gives off a tell fitting the family (a glow, a hum or crack, a smell, sparks, frost, veins lighting up, a color shift) unless the player names another; once set, it stays the same.
Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): the tell grows, seen or heard across a street, and lingers after each use.
Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; the tell comes a moment before each use, so watchers get a warning and can react; surprise attacks and hidden uses with the Quirk fail.
Quirk Strain 100: the tell flares out of control in a burst (a flash, a bang, a cloud of scent) that gives the user's position away, and the Quirk gives out until Strain falls below 60.
The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold.
Ordinary life: witnesses, cameras and police link any use to the user, so unlicensed use is almost always traced; heroes with it get recognized and photographed; vigilantes and villains with it get identified.
